name: Little Nemo 10-question smoke quiz
notes: Exact prompts from the 2026-11-26 bench session documented in docs/ACCEL-CUDA.md. Chat template on, thinking off, greedy decoding, max 16 new tokens, a fresh conversation per question. Graded by the first answer line. Headline scores in that guide: raw bf16 CPU 10/10 at about 0.07 tokens/s with clean stops; compressed CUDA pack 7/10 (7 pass, 2 hedge, 1 fail). This file does not include checkpoint or pack paths.

compressed_pack_cuda.fail_note: first line was Earth; expected Jupiter. The CPU reference on the decoded pack gave the same wrong answer.
